datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field assessments across Madagascar to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic data representing IPC phase classifications (1-5 scale) were compiled for each month of 2021 and distributed as GeoJSON and KML files.
